manual.name: LinkedIn Jobs
manual.covers: Cross-posted hospital jobs, plus some that recruiters post only here
manual.why: LinkedIn blocks automated reading, so nothing here is tracked.

manual.name: Indeed
manual.covers: Jobs from every employer, incl. small clinics and surgery centers
manual.why: Indeed limits how many pages can be read each day, so coverage is partial.

manual.name: SF VA Medical Center
manual.covers: Pre-op, PACU, GI lab, OR and women's health clinic RN jobs
manual.why: USAJobs pages can't be read automatically, so the VA isn't tracked at all.

manual.name: Highland Hospital (Alameda Health System)
manual.covers: L&D, mother-baby, NICU, OB clinic, pre/post cath lab
manual.why: The careers site blocks automated reading; jobs are checked only through Glassdoor copies, which can lag.

manual.name: Contra Costa Regional Medical Center
manual.covers: L&D / nursery / postpartum, PACU, GI lab and OR (county jobs)
manual.why: The county job site blocks automated reading; jobs are checked only through Indeed.

manual.name: San Mateo Medical Center
manual.why: The county job site blocks automated reading; jobs are checked only through job boards.

manual.name: Sequoia Hospital (Dignity Health)
manual.why: Dignity's job search is blocked; only its location pages can be read, and they can lag.

manual.name: Chinese Hospital
manual.why: Its job page often times out.

manual.name: NorthBay Health (Fairfield)
manual.why: The careers site blocks automated reading; jobs are checked through Glassdoor and Indeed.

manual.name: Stanford Health Care
manual.covers: Palo Alto, Redwood City and Tri-Valley jobs
manual.why: Its job site shows only the first 100 openings to automated readers, so some Stanford jobs can be missed.

manual.name: Sutter Health
manual.covers: CPMC, Mills-Peninsula, Alta Bates, Eden and Sutter clinics
manual.why: Sutter's job lists are cut off for automated readers; most jobs are found through Glassdoor and Built In, but a few can slip through.

manual.name: El Camino Health
manual.why: Its job site refuses automated reading; jobs are checked through Credenza and Glassdoor.

manual.name: US Fertility / Reproductive Science Center
manual.covers: IVF nurse and OR/PACU jobs (San Ramon, San Mateo, Menlo Park, Oakland)
manual.why: Its job board can't be read; jobs are found through ZipRecruiter and Glassdoor.

manual.name: Nova IVF (Ivy Fertility)
manual.why: Its job board blocks automated reading.

manual.name: Collab Fertility
manual.why: Its careers page shows no listings to automated readers.

manual.name: MedBridge surgery centers
manual.covers: The Surgery Center of Oakland, Pacific Heights Surgery Center (pre-op, PACU, OR)
manual.why: Their job board can't be read; jobs are checked through Glassdoor.

excluded.name: Hospitals more than about 55 minutes away
excluded.why: San Jose, Santa Clara, Vallejo, Antioch, Santa Rosa and similar are outside the drive limit.

excluded.name: Travel, agency and staffing-firm postings
excluded.why: Left out on purpose; only direct hospital and clinic jobs are tracked.

excluded.name: New-grad residency programs
excluded.why: She already has 4 years of experience.

excluded.name: Managers, educators, NPs, LVNs, CNAs, techs and lactation-only (IBCLC) roles
excluded.why: Not staff RN roles she's looking for.

excluded.name: Postings open only to current employees
excluded.why: For example, Washington Hospital's internal Staff Nurse III Birthing Center job.
